runs.emptyBody: Once you export an agent to CI, every automated review shows up here.
runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs
runs.emptyCta: Set up CI for an agent
runs.loadFailedBody: The CI runs could not be loaded. Try again.
runs.refreshed: Refresh finished — {count, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}} stored.

errorCodes.github_token_missing: A GitHub token is required to refresh CI runs.
errorCodes.github_scope_missing: GitHub refused access to workflow runs. The token needs classic “repo” or fine-grained “Actions: read”.
errorCodes.repo_not_accessible: The repository does not exist or the token cannot access it.
errorCodes.github_unavailable: GitHub is rate-limiting or unavailable. Try again later.

exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.blockMergeDesc: Requires a GitHub App — not available with PAT in local mode
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} from the branch {branch} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs.
exportWizard.providerNotice: CI runs use OpenRouter. Switch this agent’s provider to OpenRouter on the Config tab first.
exportWizard.workflowTooLarge: The workflow is larger than {max} KB; the server will reject it.

errors.runnerBundleUnavailable: The CI runner files are not built on the server. Run “pnpm -C agent-runner build” and try again.

exportWizard.zipCardBody: Downloads exactly the files from the preview. Nothing is sent to GitHub.

permissions.fineGrained: Fine-grained token: Contents: write, Workflows: write, Pull requests: write, Actions: read

exportWizard.doneBody: DevDigest opened a pull request with the CI files.
exportWizard.doneReused: An open setup pull request was updated.
exportWizard.zipDoneBody: Add the files to your repository to enable CI.

checklist.secret: Add {key} to the repository’s Actions secrets.
checklist.required: Optionally make the check required to block merges.
checklist.refresh: Use Refresh on the CI Runs page.

exportWizard.regenerateBody: The triggers or post mode changed, so the workflow will be regenerated and your edits to it will be lost.

ciTab.heading: Continuous Integration
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repo.
ciTab.empty: Not deployed to CI yet. Use “Publish to CI” to open a PR that adds the workflow + agent config.
ciTab.loadFailedBody: The installations could not be loaded. Try again.
ciTab.emptyBody: Run this agent automatically on every pull request in a repository’s CI pipeline.
ciTab.installedIn: Installed in {count, plural, one {# repo} other {# repos}}

failOn.title: Fail CI on
failOn.hint: Fail the check when a finding at or above this severity lands. Pair it with a required status check to block merges.
failOn.any: Any finding (set on the Config tab)

publishDialog.title: Publish to CI
publishDialog.subtitle: Run {agentName} on every pull request in {repo}
publishDialog.intro: Opens a pull request in {repo} adding a GitHub Actions workflow + this agent's config under .devdigest/. On every PR the agent reviews the diff.
publishDialog.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs. GITHUB_TOKEN is provided automatically.
publishDialog.doneBody: Opened/updated a pull request in {repo} with the workflow + agent config.
